title: Sobha Sector 63A
location: Sector 63A, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurgaon
address: Sobha Sector 63A, Sector 63A, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram, Haryana
details: Sobha Sector 63A is a premium residential landmark by SOBHA Limited, thoughtfully positioned in Sector 63A on Golf Course Extension Road, Gurgaon. Designed for contemporary luxury living, the project brings together elegant architecture, spacious residences, open green landscapes, and carefully curated lifestyle amenities that create a refined urban address. With excellent connectivity to major business corridors, premium schools, healthcare facilities, retail destinations, entertainment hubs, and commercial centers, the project offers both everyday convenience and strong long-term investment potential. The residences are planned to balance comfort, sophistication, and functionality, making them ideal for families seeking a prestigious home in one of Gurgaon’s most desirable locations. The development features 3 BHK residences of approximately 2300 sq. ft. and 4 BHK residences of approximately 2700 sq. ft., along with premium community spaces, modern recreational zones, and the trusted quality construction associated with the SOBHA brand.
cardDescription: Premium 3 & 4 BHK residences on Golf Course Extension Road with luxury amenities, green spaces, and excellent connectivity.
